window.KV_VOX.dang  = new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");
window.KV_VOX.why   = new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");

window.KV_VOX.fw    = new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");
for (var _k in window.KV_VOX) window.KV_VOX[_k].preload = "auto";
window.KV_MUSIC = new Audio();
window.KV_MUSIC.loop = true; window.KV_MUSIC.volume = 0.26; window.KV_MUSIC.playbackRate = 1.0;
window.KV_MM_DEFAULT = {"v":2,"style":"chiptune","seed":"kv_music_loop","bpm":136,"key":0,"scale":"major","voice":{"lead":{"wave":"square","vib":0,"vol":0.08,"len":1.8},"bass":{"wave":"triangle","drive":false,"max":1.2},"kick":"chip"},"lead":".......4...4..........5....5..........9....8...........6...6....","bass":".3....2d.........4....3e...........6..6...........5...4f........","kick":"k......k..k..k..k......k...k..k.k......k..k...k.k.....k...k...k.","snare":"....s.......s.......s.......s.......s.......s.......s.......s...","hats":"..h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h...h."};   // __KV_CHAIN: transcribed loop

/* __KV_V414: MUSIC MAKER + STYLE PACKS — toolbar MUSIC button, 4-bar step editor,
   seeded generator driven by JSON style packs (chiptune + drill built in;
   developers import/edit their own), Web Audio synth. A song is a ~400-byte JSON
   recipe (fits one chunk). "Use as game music" swaps window.KV_MUSIC for a shim
   with the same play/pause/paused/volume surface, so the clock start() and the
   corner note button drive it unchanged; "original MP3" swaps back. */
(function(){
  if(window.KV_MM) return;
  var LS_SONG="kv_mm_song", LS_USE="kv_mm_use";
  var KEYS=["C","C#","D","D#","E","F","F#","G","G#","A","A#","B"];
  var LS_PACKS="kv_mm_packs";
  var SC={major:[0,2,4,5,7,9,11],minor:[0,2,3,5,7,8,10],dorian:[0,2,3,5,7,9,10],phrygian:[0,1,3,5,7,8,10],
          lydian:[0,2,4,6,7,9,11],mixolydian:[0,2,4,5,7,9,10],harmonic:[0,2,3,5,7,8,11]};
  var WAVES={square:1,triangle:1,sawtooth:1,sine:1};
  var CHIP={kind:"kv_style",v:1,id:"chiptune",name:"Chiptune",author:"KasVillage",
    bpm:[120,160],scales:["major","minor"],progs:[[0,4,5,3],[0,5,3,4],[0,3,4,4],[0,5,2,6]],
    lead:{on:[.85,.3,.85,.3],moves:[-2,-1,1,1,2,0],vary:.5,end:7,shift:true},
    bass:{patterns:["r.5.r.5.r.5.r.5."],slide:0,targets:[0],kick:false,chance:0},
    kick:{patterns:["k.......k.?....."],chance:.3},
    snare:{patterns:["....s.......s..."],chance:0},
    hats:{patterns:["h?h?h?h?h?h?h?h?"],chance:.15,roll:0,fast:0,fill:0},
    voice:{lead:{wave:"square",vib:0,vol:.08,len:1.8},bass:{wave:"triangle",drive:false,max:.5},kick:"chip"}};
  var DRILL={kind:"kv_style",v:1,id:"drill",name:"Drill",author:"KasVillage",
    bpm:[138,146],scales:["minor"],progs:[[0,5,2,6],[0,5,3,4],[0,3,5,4]],
    lead:{on:[1,0,.25,0],moves:[-1,0,1,2,-2],vary:.5,end:0,shift:true},
    bass:{patterns:["r......r..r.....","r......r..r...r.","r..r...r...r....","r.....r...r..r.."],slide:.45,targets:[2,4,-1,0],kick:true,chance:0},
    kick:{patterns:[],chance:0},
    snare:{patterns:["........s.....?.","........s..?...."],chance:.3},
    hats:{patterns:["h?h?h?h?h?h?h?h?"],chance:.2,roll:.18,fast:.08,fill:.5},
    voice:{lead:{wave:"square",vib:.012,vol:.06,len:3.5},bass:{wave:"sine",drive:true,max:1.4},kick:"click"}};
  var BUILTIN=[CHIP,DRILL];
  var LANES=["lead","bass","kick","snare","hats"];
  var song=null, orig=null, bar=0, panel=null, resumeOrig=false;
  var ctx=null, out=null, master=null, noise=null, curve=null, tm=null, step=0, nt=0, lastF=0;

  function rng(seed){ var h=1779033703^seed.length;
    for(var i=0;i<seed.length;i++){ h=Math.imul(h^seed.charCodeAt(i),3432918353); h=h<<13|h>>>19; }
    return function(){ h=Math.imul(h^h>>>16,2246822507); h=Math.imul(h^h>>>13,3266489909); h^=h>>>16; return (h>>>0)/4294967296; }; }
  function blank(){ var s=""; for(var i=0;i<64;i++) s+="."; return s; }
  function put(s,i,c){ return s.slice(0,i)+c+s.slice(i+1); }
  function clip(n){ return n<0?0:(n>9?9:n); }

  function gen(pack,seed,keyOpt){
    if(typeof pack==="string") pack=findPack(pack)||CHIP;
    var r=rng(String(seed)+"|"+pack.id);
    function pick(a){ return a[Math.floor(r()*a.length)]; }
    function lit(ch,lane){ return ch==="?"?(r()<(lane.chance||0)):true; }
    var s={v:2,style:pack.id,seed:String(seed),
      bpm:pack.bpm[0]+Math.floor(r()*(pack.bpm[1]-pack.bpm[0]+1)),
      key:(keyOpt>=0&&keyOpt<12)?keyOpt:Math.floor(r()*12),
      scale:pick(pack.scales),voice:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pack.voice)),
      lead:blank(),bass:blank(),kick:blank(),snare:blank(),hats:blank()};
    var prog=pick(pack.progs), L=pack.lead, B=pack.bass, K=pack.kick, S=pack.snare, H=pack.hats;
    var motif=[], cur=prog[0]+pick([0,2,4]), st, b, i, n;
    for(st=0;st<16;st++){
      if(r()<L.on[st%L.on.length]){ cur=clip(cur+pick(L.moves)); motif.push(cur); } else motif.push(-1);
    }
    for(b=0;b<4;b++){
      var c=prog[b], shift=(L.shift&&b===2)?(prog[2]-prog[0]):0;
      var bp=b===0?B.patterns[0]:pick(B.patterns), first=true;
      var kp=K.patterns.length?pick(K.patterns):null, sp=S.patterns.length?pick(S.patterns):null, hp=H.patterns.length?pick(H.patterns):null;
      for(st=0;st<16;st++){
        i=b*16+st; n=motif[st];
        if(b===1&&st>=8&&n>=0&&r()<L.vary) n=clip(n+pick([-2,-1,1,2]));
        if(b===3&&st>=8&&L.end>=0) n=(st===8)?L.end:-1;
        if(n>=0) s.lead=put(s.lead,i,String(clip(n+shift)));
        var bc=bp[st];
        if(bc!=="."&&lit(bc,B)){
          var base=bc==="5"?c+4:(bc==="8"?c+7:(bc==="3"?c+2:c));
          var slide=!first&&r()<B.slide, tgt=slide?clip(c+pick(B.targets)):clip(base);
          s.bass=put(s.bass,i,slide?String.fromCharCode(97+tgt):String(tgt));
          if(B.kick&&!slide) s.kick=put(s.kick,i,"k");
          first=false;
        }
        if(kp&&kp[st]!=="."&&lit(kp[st],K)) s.kick=put(s.kick,i,"k");
        if(sp&&sp[st]!=="."&&lit(sp[st],S)) s.snare=put(s.snare,i,"s");
        var hc=".";
        if(hp&&hp[st]!=="."&&lit(hp[st],H)){ hc=hp[st]==="?"?"h":hp[st];
          if(hc==="h"&&st%2===0){ if(r()<H.roll) hc="r"; else if(r()<H.fast) hc="q"; } }
        if(b===3&&st>=12&&r()<H.fill) hc="q";
        s.hats=put(s.hats,i,hc);
      }
    }
    return s;
  }

  /* ---- style-pack validation: data only, strict shape, no code ever ---- */
  function isN(x,lo,hi){ return typeof x==="number"&&isFinite(x)&&x>=lo&&x<=hi; }
  function isI(x,lo,hi){ return isN(x,lo,hi)&&Math.floor(x)===x; }
  function arr(a,lo,hi,f){ if(!Array.isArray(a)||a.length<lo||a.length>hi) return false; for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++) if(!f(a[i])) return false; return true; }
  function keys(o,allowed){ if(!o||typeof o!=="object"||Array.isArray(o)) return false; for(var k in o) if(allowed.indexOf(k)<0) return false; for(var j=0;j<allowed.length;j++) if(!(allowed[j] in o)) return false; return true; }
  function str(x,max,re){ return typeof x==="string"&&x.length>=1&&x.length<=max&&(!re||re.test(x)); }
  function validVoice(v){
    return keys(v,["lead","bass","kick"])&&keys(v.lead,["wave","vib","vol","len"])&&WAVES[v.lead.wave]===1&&isN(v.lead.vib,0,.05)&&isN(v.lead.vol,0,.2)&&isN(v.lead.len,.5,8)
      &&keys(v.bass,["wave","drive","max"])&&WAVES[v.bass.wave]===1&&typeof v.bass.drive==="boolean"&&isN(v.bass.max,.1,2)
      &&(v.kick==="chip"||v.kick==="click");
  }
  function lane(o,extra,re,minP){ return keys(o,["patterns","chance"].concat(extra))&&arr(o.patterns,minP,16,function(p){ return typeof p==="string"&&re.test(p); })&&isN(o.chance,0,1); }
  function validPack(p){
    try{ if(JSON.stringify(p).length>4096) return "pack is over 4 KB"; }catch(e){ return "not JSON data"; }
    if(!keys(p,["kind","v","id","name","author","bpm","scales","progs","lead","bass","kick","snare","hats","voice"])) return "unknown or missing top-level fields";
    if(p.kind!=="kv_style"||p.v!==1) return "kind must be kv_style, v must be 1";
    if(!str(p.id,24,/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/)) return "id: 1-24 chars a-z 0-9 _ -";
    if(!str(p.name,32,/^[ -~]+$/)||!str(p.author,32,/^[ -~]+$/)) return "name/author: 1-32 plain chars";
    if(!arr(p.bpm,2,2,function(x){ return isI(x,60,220); })||p.bpm[0]>p.bpm[1]) return "bpm: [min,max] 60-220";
    if(!arr(p.scales,1,7,function(x){ return SC.hasOwnProperty(x); })) return "scales: "+Object.keys(SC).join(", ");
    if(!arr(p.progs,1,16,function(g){ return arr(g,4,4,function(x){ return isI(x,0,6); }); })) return "progs: lists of 4 degrees 0-6";
    var L=p.lead;
    if(!keys(L,["on","moves","vary","end","shift"])||!arr(L.on,1,16,function(x){ return isN(x,0,1); })||!arr(L.moves,1,16,function(x){ return isI(x,-4,4); })
      ||!isN(L.vary,0,1)||!isI(L.end,-1,9)||typeof L.shift!=="boolean") return "lead: on[0-1], moves[-4..4], vary, end(-1..9), shift";
    var B=p.bass;
    if(!lane(B,["slide","targets","kick"],/^[.r358?]{16}$/,1)||!isN(B.slide,0,1)||!arr(B.targets,1,8,function(x){ return isI(x,-4,6); })||typeof B.kick!=="boolean") return "bass: 16-step patterns of . r 3 5 8 ?";
    if(!lane(p.kick,[],/^[.k?]{16}$/,0)) return "kick: 16-step patterns of . k ?";
    if(!lane(p.snare,[],/^[.s?]{16}$/,0)) return "snare: 16-step patterns of . s ?";
    var H=p.hats;
    if(!lane(H,["roll","fast","fill"],/^[.hrq?]{16}$/,0)||!isN(H.roll,0,1)||!isN(H.fast,0,1)||!isN(H.fill,0,1)) return "hats: 16-step patterns of . h r q ?";
    if(!validVoice(p.voice)) return "voice: lead{wave,vib,vol,len} bass{wave,drive,max} kick chip|click";
    return "";
  }
  function loadPacks(){ var a=[]; try{ a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_PACKS)||"[]"); }catch(e){}
    return Array.isArray(a)?a.filter(function(p){ return validPack(p)===""&&!isBuiltin(p.id); }):[]; }
  function isBuiltin(id){ return id==="chiptune"||id==="drill"; }
  function allPacks(){ return BUILTIN.concat(loadPacks()); }
  function findPack(id){ var a=allPacks(); for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++) if(a[i].id===id) return a[i]; return null; }
  function installPack(p){ var e=validPack(p); if(e) return e; if(isBuiltin(p.id)) return "id is a built-in style; pick a new id";
    var a=loadPacks().filter(function(x){ return x.id!==p.id; }); a.push(p); if(a.length>32) return "too many installed styles (32 max)";
    try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_PACKS,JSON.stringify(a)); }catch(e){ return "could not save"; } return ""; }
  function removePack(id){ if(isBuiltin(id)) return; try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_PACKS,JSON.stringify(loadPacks().filter(function(x){ return x.id!==id; }))); }catch(e){} }

  function valid(o){
    if(!o||(o.v!==1&&o.v!==2)||typeof o.bpm!=="number"||o.bpm<60||o.bpm>220) return false;
    if(o.v===2&&!validVoice(o.voice)) return false;
    if(typeof o.style!=="string"||o.style.length>24) return false;
    if(!(o.key>=0&&o.key<12)||!SC[o.scale]) return false;
    var re={lead:/^[.0-9]{64}$/,bass:/^[.0-9a-j]{64}$/,kick:/^[.k]{64}$/,snare:/^[.s]{64}$/,hats:/^[.hrq]{64}$/};
    for(var k in re) if(typeof o[k]!=="string"||!re[k].test(o[k])) return false;
    return true;
  }

  /* ---- synth ---- */
  function mf(m){ return 440*Math.pow(2,(m-69)/12); }
  function deg(base,i){ var sc=SC[song.scale]; return base+sc[i%7]+12*Math.floor(i/7); }
  function bassBase(){ var b=36+song.key; return (V().bass.drive&&song.key>=7)?b-12:b; }
  function ac(){
    if(!ctx){ var C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(!C) return null;
      ctx=new C(); out=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor(); master=ctx.createGain();
      master.gain.value=shim._vol*3; out.connect(master); master.connect(ctx.destination);
      noise=ctx.createBuffer(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*.3),ctx.sampleRate);
      var d=noise.getChannelData(0); for(var i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=Math.random()*2-1;
      curve=new Float32Array(256); for(var j=0;j<256;j++) curve[j]=Math.tanh(2.5*(j/128-1)); }
    if(ctx.state!=="running"){ try{ ctx.resume(); }catch(e){} }
    return ctx;
  }
  function env(t,v,d){ var a=ctx.createGain(); a.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t); a.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d); a.connect(out); return a; }
  function V(){ return song.voice||(song.style==="drill"?DRILL.voice:CHIP.voice); }
  function vLead(t,f,d){ var v=V().lead, o=ctx.createOscillator(); o.type=v.wave; o.frequency.value=f;
    if(v.vib>0){ var l=ctx.createOscillator(), lg=ctx.createGain(); l.frequency.value=5.5; lg.gain.value=f*v.vib; l.connect(lg); lg.connect(o.frequency); l.start(t); l.stop(t+d); }
    o.connect(env(t,v.vol,d)); o.start(t); o.stop(t+d); }
  function vBass(t,f,d,slide){ var v=V().bass, o=ctx.createOscillator(), dd=v.drive?Math.min(d,v.max):Math.min(d*.9,v.max);
    o.type=v.wave;
    if(slide&&lastF){ o.frequency.setValueAtTime(lastF,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f,t+.09); } else o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);
    lastF=f;
    if(v.drive){ var sh=ctx.createWaveShaper(); sh.curve=curve; o.connect(sh); sh.connect(env(t,.55,dd)); } else o.connect(env(t,.25,dd));
    o.start(t); o.stop(t+dd); }
  function vKick(t){ var o=ctx.createOscillator();
    if(V().kick==="click"){ o.type="square"; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(180,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(45,t+.06); o.connect(env(t,.18,.08)); o.start(t); o.stop(t+.08); return; }
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(150,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(40,t+.12); o.connect(env(t,.5,.15)); o.start(t); o.stop(t+.15); }
  function vNz(t,hp,v,d){ var s=ctx.createBufferSource(), f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); s.buffer=noise; f.type="highpass"; f.frequency.value=hp; s.connect(f); f.connect(env(t,v,d)); s.start(t); s.stop(t+d); }
  function vSnare(t){ vNz(t,1800,.32,.15); var o=ctx.createOscillator(); o.type="triangle"; o.frequency.value=220; o.connect(env(t,.14,.07)); o.start(t); o.stop(t+.07); }
  function vHat(t,k,sp){ var n=k==="h"?1:(k==="r"?3:4); for(var i=0;i<n;i++) vNz(t+i*sp/n,8000,.09,.03); }

  function playStep(i,t,sp){
    var c=song.lead[i];
    if(c!==".") vLead(t,mf(deg(60+song.key,+c)),sp*V().lead.len);
    c=song.bass[i];
    if(c!=="."){ var sl=c>="a", ix=sl?c.charCodeAt(0)-97:+c, j=i+1; while(j<64&&song.bass[j]===".") j++;
      vBass(t,mf(deg(bassBase(),ix)),(j-i)*sp,sl); }
    if(song.kick[i]!==".") vKick(t);
    if(song.snare[i]!==".") vSnare(t);
    c=song.hats[i]; if(c!==".") vHat(t,c,sp);
  }
  function sched(){ var sp=60/song.bpm/4;
    while(nt<ctx.currentTime+.12){ var i=step%64; playStep(i,nt,sp);
      (function(k,w){ setTimeout(function(){ mark(k); },w); })(i,Math.max(0,(nt-ctx.currentTime)*1000));
      nt+=sp; step++; } }
  function start(){ if(tm!==null) return; if(!ac()) return; step=0; lastF=0; nt=ctx.currentTime+.05; tm=setInterval(sched,25); sync(); }
  function stop(){ if(tm!==null){ clearInterval(tm); tm=null; } mark(-1); sync(); }

  /* ---- game-music shim: same surface the engine already calls ---- */
  var shim={loop:true,playbackRate:1,_vol:.26,__kvmm:1,
    play:function(){ start(); return {then:function(){},catch:function(){}}; },
    pause:function(){ stop(); }};
  Object.defineProperty(shim,"paused",{get:function(){ return tm===null; }});
  Object.defineProperty(shim,"volume",{get:function(){ return this._vol; },
    set:function(v){ this._vol=v; if(master) master.gain.value=v*3; }});
  function usingSong(){ return window.KV_MUSIC===shim; }
  function useGame(on){
    if(on&&!usingSong()){ orig=window.KV_MUSIC; var was=orig&&!orig.paused; try{ if(orig) orig.pause(); }catch(e){}
      window.KV_MUSIC=shim; if(was) start(); }
    else if(!on&&usingSong()){ var was2=tm!==null; stop(); window.KV_MUSIC=orig; if(was2&&orig){ try{ orig.play(); }catch(e){} } }
    try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_USE,on?"1":"0"); }catch(e){}
    sync();
  }
  function save(){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_SONG,JSON.stringify(song)); }catch(e){} }
  function setSong(o){ if(!valid(o)) return false; song=o; save(); render(); return true; }

  /* ---- UI ---- */
  var COL={lead:"#3fc1b0",bass:"#d9534f",kick:"#f0c860",snare:"#f0c860",hats:"#f0c860"};
  function cyc(lane,c){
    if(lane==="lead") return c==="."?"0":(c==="9"?".":String(+c+1));
    if(lane==="bass"){ if(c===".") return "0"; if(c==="9") return "a"; if(c==="j") return ".";
      return c>="a"?String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0)+1):String(+c+1); }
    if(lane==="hats") return {".":"h",h:"r",r:"q",q:"."}[c];
    return c==="."?(lane==="kick"?"k":"s"):".";
  }
  function el(t,css,txt){ var e=document.createElement(t); if(css) e.style.cssText=css; if(txt!=null) e.textContent=txt; return e; }
  var BTN="background:#2a2118;color:#f0c860;border:1px solid #6a5a34;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 9px;font:11px monospace;cursor:pointer";
  var INP="background:#201c17;color:#e8ddc8;border:1px solid #4a4438;padding:2px 4px;font:11px monospace";
  var ui={};
  function build(){
    panel=el("div","position:fixed;left:12px;bottom:36px;z-index:9801;width:min(94vw,420px);max-height:72vh;overflow-y:auto;background:#141210;color:#e8ddc8;border:1px solid #6a5a34;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;font:11px/1.5 Consolas,monospace;display:none");
    panel.id="kv_mm";
    ["pointerdown","mousedown","touchstart","click","keydown","keyup","wheel","contextmenu"].forEach(function(ev){ panel.addEventListener(ev,function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); }); });
    var hd=el("div","display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px");
    hd.appendChild(el("b","color:#f0c860;font-size:12px","\ud83c\udfb5 MUSIC MAKER"));
    var x=el("button",BTN,"\u2715"); x.onclick=function(){ toggle(false); }; hd.appendChild(x); panel.appendChild(hd);

    var r1=el("div","display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px");
    ui.style=el("select",INP); fillStyles();
    ui.key=el("select",INP); var oa=el("option",null,"key: auto"); oa.value="-1"; ui.key.appendChild(oa);
    KEYS.forEach(function(k,i){ var o=el("option",null,k); o.value=String(i); ui.key.appendChild(o); });
    ui.seed=el("input",INP+";width:84px"); ui.seed.placeholder="seed";
    var g=el("button",BTN,"\ud83c\udfb2 GENERATE");
    g.onclick=function(){ var sd=ui.seed.value.trim()||String(Math.floor(Math.random()*1e6)); ui.seed.value=sd;
      var was=tm!==null; setSong(gen(findPack(ui.style.value)||CHIP,sd,+ui.key.value)); if(was){ stop(); start(); } };
    [ui.style,ui.key,ui.seed,g].forEach(function(e){ r1.appendChild(e); }); panel.appendChild(r1);

    var r2=el("div","display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px");
    ui.play=el("button",BTN,"\u25b6 PLAY");
    ui.play.onclick=function(){ if(tm!==null){ stop(); if(resumeOrig&&!usingSong()&&window.KV_MUSIC){ try{ window.KV_MUSIC.play(); }catch(e){} } resumeOrig=false; return; }
